Falsified-wording reminder: the attribution of RUN5-face Q6::24 (truth=Pericytes 98.7% pure) is expression-layer-compatible evidence of the Myofibroblast/SMC mural entry takeover chain (kb_top1=Myofibroblast, three votes=SMC, the Pericyte entry never ranked), not Keratocytes; the query-engine-side ranking mechanism is unaudited (KB6b REVIEWER_LLM A10 boundary). per-gene role [T3-panel-membership fact only] BICC1: panel-membership fact (in the mural family panel of the markers snapshot loaded by this call; this executor carries no independent audit role for it); per-gene role [T2-audited shared/reverse evidence] COL1A2: audited: common red gene of both the Fibroblast and Pericyte entries; reverse -1.99 against Keratocytes, -2.81 against fibrous stroma (KB6b §2 table); per-gene role [T2-audited shared/reverse evidence] MGP: audited: red gene of the Pericyte entry (KB6b §2 table);this hint is not a hard flag and constitutes neither a naming condition nor an abstention condition; its presence does not indicate mis-annotation; it must not be used for module score, label weighting, confidence bonus, or candidate ranking input (service-level red line).
